plan.title: Test Pointer Coordinate Normalization Across Event Types
plan.body: `tests/backend_consistency.rs` — add tests for PointerMoved, PointerDown, PointerUp, Drag all reporting coordinates in window-logical units. Verify clicks at (0,0), (800,600), and middle positions all normalize correctly. Acceptance: `cargo test --test backend_consistency::pointer_coordinates -- --nocapture` passes; positions match expected logical coordinates.

plan.title: Test Event Batching Consistency
plan.body: `tests/backend_consistency.rs` — add tests that inject multiple events (mousemove + click + mousemove) in one frame and verify all events appear in Input state in same frame. Acceptance: `cargo test --test backend_consistency::events_batch_in_same_frame` passes; verifies Input accumulates all events before frame boundary.

plan.title: Test Appearance Toggle Consistency
plan.body: `tests/backend_consistency.rs` — add tests verifying that appearance changes (light/dark mode) reflect immediately in next frame without requiring restart or special handling. Acceptance: `cargo test --test backend_consistency::appearance_updates_reflect_immediately` passes.

plan.title: Test Key Event Consistency
plan.body: `tests/backend_consistency.rs` — add tests for KeyDown, KeyUp, Text events with different modifiers. Verify same key sequences produce identical Input state. Acceptance: `cargo test --test backend_consistency::key_events_consistent` passes.

plan.title: Test Scroll Event Consistency
plan.body: `tests/backend_consistency.rs` — add tests for scroll events (wheel, trackpad). Verify scroll amounts accumulate correctly. Acceptance: `cargo test --test backend_consistency::scroll_events_consistent` passes.

plan.title: Test Pointer Button Consistency
plan.body: `tests/backend_consistency.rs` — add tests for all three buttons (Primary, Secondary, Middle) with press/release sequences. Verify button tracking is consistent. Acceptance: `cargo test --test backend_consistency::pointer_buttons_consistent` passes.

plan.title: Verify Platform-Specific Coordinate Transforms Match Spec
plan.body: Add unit tests directly to platform backend files (macos.rs, windows.rs, x11.rs, wasm.rs) validating coordinate conversion functions handle scale factors uniformly. Acceptance: `cargo test --lib pixel_conversion` and `cargo test --lib shell` pass; coordinate transform tests verify scale-aware normalization.

plan.title: Test Event Sequencing With State Mutations
plan.body: `tests/backend_consistency.rs` — add end-to-end test simulating complete interaction sequence: move pointer → press button → drag → release → key press → toggle appearance → verify state is consistent after each step. Acceptance: `cargo test --test backend_consistency::interaction_sequence_is_consistent` passes.

plan.title: Run Full Backend Consistency Test Suite
plan.body: Execute `cargo test --test backend_consistency` to run all consistency checks. Verify no platform-specific deviations in event handling. Acceptance: All tests pass; no platform-conditional branches in event processing above Backend trait.

plan.title: Document Coordinate System Contract

plan.title: Final Verification Across Platforms
